transition: s_next = action % num_states; all rewards zero; no termination; Q*=V*=0
noise_convention: All IQL variants at D=1 use current target-Q observation (epsilon_t), current V and the self/peer index to construct the gate. At D>1 all freeze the observed target-Q plus V after each D updates, as before. The earlier SD/DD used epsilon_(t-1) in D=1 filters; that mismatch is corrected.
metric: mean_s max_a mean_i clean Q_i(s,a), true Q*=0; sample SD across 20 seeds; checkpoints at 100000 and 1000000
comparison: Matched S=A=2,4,8,16 sweeps at 100000 and 1000000 total updates. Expected Q(s,a) visits at 100k: 25000,6250,1562.5,390.625; at 1M: 250000,62500,15625,3906.25. State/action sizes grow together. Two-action noise retains the original first two of four field outputs.
initialization: All clean Q, V, Q-target tables start at zero; delayed observed Q initially includes the first noise field.
